tei:div.tei:p: (pha)༄༅// yang bkra shis bzhugs// ༄༅// bla ma la na mo/ dpal mchog bde chen 'gyur med rtag pa'i sku// dpal chen rdo rje phag mos nyer 'khril ba'i// dpal ldan phun sum tshogs pa thams cad kyis// dpal mo khyod ni rtag tu skyong gyur cig /go go can la'o// //a bhi dha na'i le'u nyi shu rtsa lnga pa las/ thog ma bar dang tha mar ni// dam tshig nyams pa bskang ba dang*// dpa' bo dang ni rnal 'byor ma// 'khor lo dag ni bstan pa'i phyir// yi ge brgya pa'i gsang sngags bzlas// oṃ badz+ra he ru ka sa ma ya ma nu pā la ya/ he ru ka twe no pa tiṣ+ṭha/ dṛ ḍho me bha ba/ su to ṣ+yo me bha ba/ a nu rak+to me bha ba/ su po ṣ+yo me bha ba/ sarba sid+dhi m+me pra yats+tsha/ sarba karma su tsa me/ tsit+taṃ shre yaḥku ru hūm̐/ ha ha ha ha hoḥ bha ga bān badz+ra he ru ka mā me muñtsa he ru ko bha ba/ ma hā sa ma ya satwa ā hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces 'byung ngo*// // ༈ gu rus dpar rtsa spel ba'o//
